title: Locate the Horn
introduction:
I use the transparent vehicle view to find the horn assembly, then follow the leader to the enlarged inset to recognize its paired round housings and shared bracket. The drawing makes the bodywork see-through, which is handy when the noisemaker is better hidden than its voice suggests.

Match the inset's circled callout to the Item/Description table. Its location comment identifies the splash shield concealing the assembly; LH means left-hand. This is a location reference. Shield removal, horn removal and electrical diagnosis require separate instructions.
